Brick Install
Our brick installation system makes adding the look of masonry brick quick and efficient, without the mortar and mess. In this video, Zach and Amanda will walk you through how to attach the panels to your wall as well as how to make a beginner and advanced cut.

How To Video

Manager and Director

Exterior Stone Install
Installing GenStone on the exterior of your property is as easy as measure, cut with any saw and attach. In this video, Zach and Amanda will walk you through and exterior install from unboxing through the finishing touches.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Interior Stone Install
From unboxing your order to installing panels, corners, ledgers, trim and finished edges, Zach and Amanda take you on a step by step journey through an interior GenStone installation.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Columns Install
Four 90º outside corner panels fit together to add the look of stone to a 17" square column. Each outside corner panel is 23.50" tall, but can be stacked vertically for taller columns or cut down for shorter projects.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Pillar Install
Each pillar panel is 48" tall and designed to fit together in groups of four panels around an 7.75" square post. Pillar panels can be stacked vertically for taller posts or cut down and pieced together to dress up a shorter post.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Wood Install
GenStone faux wood wall panels are faster and easier to install than real reclaimed barnwood. In this video, Zach and Amanda will walk you through laying out your wall to achieve the perfect color combination through attaching the panels to the wall.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Steel Building Install
GenStone Brick, Stone or Wood and be installed directly over the high ribs of your steel building's siding. See how to install furring strips, closure strips and GenStone to upgrade your building's curb appeal and R-Value.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Bradford Fireplace Install
Follow Zach and Amanda through this step by step tutorial demonstrating how to install our Bradford Fireplace Kit. From the wood frame that simple enough for anyone to create to installing the GenStone and mounting the fireplace, you won't believe how quickly and easily you can create a fireplace on any wall with an outlet.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Shaffer Fireplace Kit Install
Amanda and Zach walk through how to install the Shaffer Fireplace Kit step by step. Starting with just a wall and an outlet, watch how to build a DIY friendly wood frame designed to accommodate both the GenStone and the electric fireplace, this kit goes up quickly and easy providing you with the look of a stone masonry fireplace for a fraction of the cost.

How To Video

Zach Erhardt and Amanda Lombard
Manager and Director

Big Stretch Caulking
We recommend one tube of our Big Stretch caulking for every 100 SQFT of GenStone installed to create a water tight connection between panels, ledgers and trim.

How To Video

Exact Color Caulking
Exact Color caulking is tinted with a GenStone paint kit. Tinting the caulking allows the installer to blend and conceal fastener holes with little to no touch up paint necessary.

How To Video

Our panelized brick installation system slides together quickly and easily creating the look of a masonry wall without the mortar and without the mess.
